title: Password Sign-up Flow
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant IBM Verify

    User->>Frontend: Enter registration details
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /api/auth/signup
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Get admin token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Admin token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/Users
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Create user with SCIM 2.0
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: User created
    Backend-->>Frontend: Success response
    Frontend->>Frontend: Redirect to sign-in
